# GlobaCart GH

> Shop Global, Pay Local. Dependable e-commerce delivery across Ghana.

## About GlobaCart GH
GlobaCart GH (https://www.globacartgh.com) is a modern Ghanaian e-commerce platform offering top quality electronics, fashion, home essentials, and lifestyle products. We bridge global shopping with local convenience and dependable delivery across all 16 regions of Ghana.

## Key Features & Services
- **Payment Methods**: Online card or Mobile Money payment through Paystack (Visa, Mastercard, Mobile Money).
- **Delivery Coverage**: Fast delivery across Greater Accra (1-2 business days) and nationwide across Ghana (Ashanti, Central, Eastern, Western, Northern regions, etc., within 3-5 business days).
- **Returns & Warranty**: 14-day hassle-free return window for unused items in original packaging.
- **Authenticity**: 100% genuine products directly sourced from verified merchants.
